description: This bar chart, titled "How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception," illustrates the popularity of various large language models (LLMs) across three different knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis, labeled "Popularity," is scaled linearly from 20 to 220, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. For each domain, six bars are grouped together, representing different LLMs and answer types: Llama3 (blue with diagonal hatching), Qwen2 (red with diagonal hatching), ChatGPT (yellow with diagonal hatching), Acc=0 & GT Ans (blue with cross-hatching), Acc=0 & Gene Ans (blue with diagonal hatching), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (white with diagonal hatching). The bars are arranged in descending order of height within each group, with the tallest bar in each group corresponding to the Llama3 model for Movies (approximately 60), Qwen2 for Songs (approximately 80), and Qwen2 for Basketball (approximately 220). The shortest bars are consistently the Acc=0 & Gene Ans category for Movies (approximately 20) and Acc=1 & GT Ans for Songs (approximately 20). The chart visually emphasizes the Llama3 model in each domain through its consistent height and distinct blue color, while the Acc=0 & GT Ans and Acc=1 & GT Ans categories are represented by different patterns and colors, indicating different answer types.
